turns.text: Yeah, it feels completely fine now! No stiffness during any of the weight-bearing holds, which is a huge relief. I'm hoping to get back to some outdoor photography walks soon too, once the snow clears up a bit.

So we decided to break our usual routine and ordered a hot, cheesy baked pie with our favorite toppings delivered straight to the house instead.
